## Prompt set

Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE new high-resolution photo-style cosmetics category icon for SeoulBeauty, part of a coordinated asset family. The reference is only for consistent photographic style, soft lighting and polish. Subject: SUBJECT. Single square 1254 by 1254 image. Centered, entire object visible, fills approximately 80–85 percent of image height with balanced minimal margins. Pale warm off-white studio background without a frame, realistic plastic/glass/powder materials, crisp professional product photography, soft grounded shadow. Consistent soft pastel beauty aesthetic. No brand, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, border, or additional decorative objects. Attractive and immediately recognizable at a 58px mobile UI size, exceptionally sharp edges on high-density displays. This is generic decorative category art, not a photograph of a named commercial product.
